description: Workspace manifest decoding (schema version 1). Each case gives the JSON TEXT to decode and the expected outcome. Shared by the TypeScript decoder tests and the Rust decoder tests. TypeScript is the behavioural reference. Error shape: {code} or {field, code} or {code, version}. Unpaired surrogates are written as JSON escape sequences inside the input text, so they are portable.
